name: Feathers for Binding

angles.text: Herbalists and natural healers can value the balance of moss, antiseptic tree sap, and insulating feathers in a field dressing or medicinal poultice.
As a druid, you may share the caretakers’ sorrow over slaying young woodland beasts, even when rising aggression and urgent medical need leave few alternatives.

faq.answer: Young Shadowgale shrieklings’ feathers insulate the poultice. Laid over moss and antiseptic sap, they keep the sap from drying and shield wounds from harsh weather.
faq.q: Why are Shadowgale shriekling feathers needed for the poultice?

faq.answer: Shadowgale shrieklings are usually docile, but lately they have grown unusually hostile. Even the young have large, vicious talons that can disembowel an unwary traveler.
faq.q: How dangerous are the juvenile shrieklings?

faq.answer: The caretakers regret culling young shrieklings, but their sudden aggression and competing wilderness emergencies make thinning their numbers a painful necessity. Gathering their feathers also helps meet urgent medical needs.
faq.q: Why must juvenile shrieklings be hunted instead of adults?

faq.answer: Shadowgale shrieklings roam the canopies and underbrush of Shadowgale Forest. Travelers must venture carefully through the woods to find them.
faq.q: Where are the Shadowgale shrieklings found?

faq.answer: The poultice uses local moss and antiseptic sap, bound and insulated with feathers from young shrieklings.
faq.q: What other ingredients are being used alongside these feathers?

faq.answer: No one knows the exact cause of the shrieklings’ sudden hostility. The normally peaceful young creatures have grown aggressive, adding to the crises facing local caretakers.
faq.q: Why have the shrieklings become so hostile lately?

sections.body: Field healers in Shadowgale Forest treat grave injuries with moss and antiseptic tree sap. Harsh weather can dry the sap or rob it of its strength. So they bind the poultice with young Shadowgale shrieklings’ feathers, which shield the wound and hold the medicine in place.
sections.title: Remedies of the Forest

sections.body: Gathering the soft feathers has grown dangerous. Young Shadowgale shrieklings are usually docile woodland dwellers, but lately they have turned inexplicably aggressive. Their strong talons can inflict lethal wounds. Now the fledglings strike at passersby.
sections.title: Uncharacteristic Hostility

sections.body: Local caretakers mourn the need to cull young beasts. Yet emergencies threaten the region, and the shrieklings grow more dangerous. Thinning their numbers gathers vital curative materials and curbs a rising threat along forest paths. Each feather is treated with respect, so the beasts’ sacrifice is not wasted.
sections.title: A Regrettable Necessity

summary: In Shadowgale Forest, healers need young shrieklings’ feathers to bind a healing poultice. The usually docile birds now attack travelers, making the plumage dangerous to gather.
attribution: In-game quest text: Feathers for Binding
